verdict: The finite dual-window arithmetic and all frozen-payload totals are independently correct. M179 is a credible analytic opportunity DSE, not yet an executable or physical FC2 module. Keep 3.377592x only as a same-window K1/K4 ablation; an independently optimized D1 K1 baseline gives 3.323847x. Producer, token directory, cross-entry selector, reordered arithmetic, weight delivery and accumulator context remain blocking boundaries.

independent_recompute.decode: numpy.unpackbits bitorder=little; bank equals input-channel modulo eight

finite_buffer_recurrence_audit.source_fill: one descriptor per cycle, in token order
finite_buffer_recurrence_audit.window_close: a window drains only after all of its D or final-partial descriptors have filled
finite_buffer_recurrence_audit.drain: one bank-unique group result per output-block cycle; window drains serialize
finite_buffer_recurrence_audit.ping_pong_overlap: the alternate buffer may fill while the current buffer drains
finite_buffer_recurrence_audit.reuse: a physical buffer cannot refill until its own prior drain completes
finite_buffer_recurrence_audit.D1_result: strict per-token equality to the independent explicit-zero-EOT M176 recurrence for K1 and K4
finite_buffer_recurrence_audit.qualification: M179 substitutes a free, early descriptor-count directory for the explicit EOT transport. D1 numerical equality does not implement or latency-account that directory.

stage_adaptive_audit.selection_bias_finding: The chosen depths are numerically correct in-sample minima, but the same payload population selected and evaluated them. This does not establish an unbiased generalization point.

optimized_baseline_finding.admission: Use 3.377592x only for a same-window structural ablation. Use at most 3.323847x when comparing independently optimized analytic K1 and K4 frontend schedules.

admitted: The frozen H67 ep35 120-FC2-record payload population has the published SHA, size, popcount, event, descriptor and bank-pressure totals.

Under one native/preindexed descriptor per cycle, a free early token descriptor count, two finite ping-pong buffers and one group-result drain per output-block cycle, all D and K wall-cycle totals are exact for the specified recurrence.
D1 exactly reproduces the M176 explicit-EOT frontend wall totals: K1 424060394 and K4 144146504 cycles.
The in-sample K4 minima are D={2,4,8,8}; their selected K4 total is 127581198 and D1/selected K4 is 1.129841280x.
The same-window selected-depth K1/K4 ablation is 430917270/127581198=3.377592284x.
forbidden: Calling 3.377592x an independently optimized baseline speedup; the optimized analytic K1 numerator is 424060394 and the resulting ratio is 3.323847092x.

Precommit D={2,4,8,8} on a disjoint tuning population and evaluate on held-out sequences or checkpoints. Current runner-up margins are only 0.052 to 0.587 percent, so selection noise and missing control costs can change the winner.

Run a matched D4/D8 selector and storage area, timing and energy comparison. Stage2 gains only 0.244327 percent from D8 over D4, while stage3 D8 is only 0.051974 percent ahead of D16.
